The '''Myomer strength enhancer system''' (MSES) was a type of [[Strength enhancing system/Legends|strength enhancing system]] made by [[Atlas Corp]].

==Characteristics==
The MSES was composed of a matrix of electrically controlled myomer synthetic muscle fibers backed up with nano-hydraulics. This matrix acted to increase a user's raw physical strength, and could be applied to most full-body hard armor suits.

==History==
The MSES was available in the period after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
